how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through tet.sikkim.gov.in, between 24 August 2026 and 12 September 2026 (by 4:00 p.m.). Before starting the online form, candidates should keep the following ready:

Scanned photo ID proof (Certificate of Identification/Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving Licence, etc.)
A working personal e-mail address and mobile number
Candidates must use their own mobile number and e-mail ID while submitting the application, since STET alerts are sent only to the registered mobile number and e-mail ID.
important_instructions: On the OMR Answer Sheet, candidates should answer all the questions. A light, faint, or incompletely darkened circle is considered a wrong marking method and is liable to be rejected by the optical scanner. Candidates must mention their own mobile number and e-mail ID while submitting the online application, as STET alerts are sent only through these registered contact details.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only In-Service Regular Teachers who meet the minimum educational qualification for their intended level are eligible. A candidate may appear for only one level - Primary or Graduate - matching their own qualification, in this cycle. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.); OR Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); OR Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education). B.A./B.Sc. with 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.); OR B.A./B.Sc. with 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 2-year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed.); OR Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); OR Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST, OBC-Central, OBC-State) and a passed 4-year B.A/B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed. Only a Diploma/Degree course in Teacher Education recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) will be considered. For Diploma in Education (Special Education) and B.Ed. (Special Education), only a course recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The test consists of objective-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), with no negative marking. Total number of MCQs: 150. All questions are compulsory. Both Level-I (Primary) and Level-II (Graduate) papers are held on the same day: 11 October 2026. Child Development and Pedagogy focuses on Educational Psychology of Teaching and Learning relevant to the 6–11 years age group. Language-I focuses on proficiencies related to the Medium of Instruction, which is English. Language-II may be any one vernacular language taught in Sikkim's schools from Class I–V (Lepcha, Bhutia, Nepali, Limboo, Hindi, Tamang, Rai, Gurung, or Sherpa); candidates must specify their choice in the application form. Child Development and Pedagogy focuses on Educational Psychology of Teaching and Learning relevant to the 11–14 years age group. Language-I focuses on proficiencies related to the Medium of Instruction, which is English. Language-II may be any one language other than Language-I, from the same vernacular options taught in Classes VI–VIII in Sikkim's schools, with test items also covering language, communication, and comprehension abilities. Mathematics and Science test items are 30 marks each, focused on concepts, problem-solving abilities, and pedagogical understanding. Social Studies test items are 60 marks, evenly distributed between History, Geography, and Civics as prescribed for Classes VI–VIII by the State Government. Paper II questions are based on the state-prescribed syllabus for Classes VI–VIII, though difficulty level and linkage may extend up to the Senior Secondary stage. The question paper is in English, with vernacular-language questions appearing in the chosen vernacular (Lepcha, Bhutia, Nepali, Limboo, Hindi, Tamang, Rai, Gurung, or Sherpa).

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Passing Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate scoring 60% or more is considered STET pass. A 5% relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, Central OBC, and State OBC candidates (i.e., 55%). All candidates who pass are awarded a certificate. The certificate is valid until the candidate crosses the "employability age" as per State Government norms - this validity period does not include the special higher-age exemption given to temporary in-service employees. STET is conducted once a year; a candidate who has already qualified may reappear in subsequent years to improve their score. Qualifying STET does not itself confer any right to recruitment or employment - it is only one of the eligibility criteria for appointment.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: An online payment of Rs. 500 (Rupees Five Hundred) is required as the examination fee. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sikkim STET 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, through tet.sikkim.gov.in, between 24 August 2026 and 12 September 2026 (by 4:00 p.m.). Before starting the online form, candidates should keep the following ready: Scanned/digital photograph of the applicant Scanned signature of the applicant Scanned professional degree/diploma certificate of the applicant Scanned photo ID proof (Certificate of Identification/Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving Licence, etc.) A working personal e-mail address and mobile number Candidates must use their own mobile number and e-mail ID while submitting the application, since STET alerts are sent only to the registered mobile number and e-mail ID.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Exam Centre
content_sections.text: Candidates can choose either Gangtok, Namchi, or Gyalshing District as their desired exam centre.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim STET 2026 Admit Card and Certificate
content_sections.text: Admit cards can be downloaded from tet.sikkim.gov.in from 1 October 2026 onwards. All successful candidates will be awarded the certificate in person, after producing the original admit card issued to them.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: On the OMR Answer Sheet, candidates should answer all the questions. Since there is no negative marking, one of the options should be properly and fully blackened - options should not be left blank. A light, faint, or incompletely darkened circle is considered a wrong marking method and is liable to be rejected by the optical scanner. Candidates must mention their own mobile number and e-mail ID while submitting the online application, as STET alerts are sent only through these registered contact details.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sikkim STET 2026?
faq.answer: It is the State Teacher Eligibility Test-2026 (For In-Service Regular Teacher), conducted by the Department of Education, Government of Sikkim, under Reference No. 75/Exam/Edn./2026 dated 30-07-2026, to determine eligibility for appointment as Primary Teacher (Classes I–V) or Graduate Teacher (Classes VI–VIII).

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for Sikkim STET 2026?
faq.answer: Only In-Service Regular Teachers who meet the prescribed educational qualification for the Primary or Graduate level are eligible. It is not open to fresh graduates or candidates outside regular teaching service.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sikkim STET 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 12 September 2026, by 4:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Sikkim STET 2026 exam?
faq.answer: The exam is on 11 October 2026 (Sunday). Both Level-I (Primary) and Level-II (Graduate) papers are conducted on the same day.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Sikkim STET 2026?
faq.answer: For Primary Teacher: Senior Secondary with the prescribed marks plus a recognized D.El.Ed., B.El.Ed., or Diploma in Special Education. For Graduate Teacher: a Bachelor's degree with a D.El.Ed. or B.Ed., or Senior Secondary with a 4-year B.El.Ed. or B.A/B.Sc.Ed. See the Eligibility section above for full details.
